records.jp: 亜子、聞きたいことがあるんだけど
records.en_original: Hey Ako, there's something I want to ask you.
records.en_auxiliary: Hey Ako, there's something I want to ask you.
records.en: Hey Ako, there's something I want to ask you.

records.jp: ん、どうしたの？
records.en_original: Oh? Ask away.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh? Ask away.
records.en: Hm? What's up?

records.jp: 特待科の多谷史緒って子、知ってる？
records.en_original: Do you know Fumio Taya, from the special class?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you know Fumio Taya, from the special class?
records.en: Do you know Taya Fumio, from the Special Class?

records.jp: ああもちろん、天才ピアニストって有名だからね。<CR>星ノ宮でピアノやっている子なら知らない人はいないよ！
records.en_original: Oh, of course, she's a famous piano prodigy. Everyone at Hoshinomiya who plays piano knows her!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, of course, she's a famous piano prodigy. Everyone at Hoshinomiya who plays piano knows her!
records.en: Of course. She's famous as a piano prodigy.<CR>Everyone at Hoshinomiya who plays piano knows her!

records.jp: 絶対音感も持ってるって話だねー
records.en_original: I've heard she even has perfect pitch!
records.en_auxiliary: I've heard she even has perfect pitch!
records.en: I've heard she even has perfect pitch!

records.jp: ちょっと、まぁ別の意味でも変……天才だけど、<CR>そこも含めて面白い取材対象だよね！
records.en_original: She's also got the whole oddball genius thing going on. ...Oh man, she'd be a perfect interview subject, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: She's also got the whole oddball genius thing going on. ...Oh man, she'd be a perfect interview subject, huh?
records.en: She's a bit...well, strange in another sense too—but she's a genius.<CR>That only makes her a more interesting interview subject!

records.jp: なになに？　ヒナちゃん気になる子がいるの？
records.en_original: What's this? Is Hina interested in someone?
records.en_auxiliary: What's this? Is Hina interested in someone?
records.en: What's this? Is Hina-chan interested in someone?

records.jp: ライムたちにも教えてよ
records.en_original: Fill us in.
records.en_auxiliary: Fill us in.
records.en: Tell Lime and the others too.

records.jp: 別に……昨日音楽室の前でちょっと話しただけだよ
records.en_original: It's nothing, really... I just kind of ran into her in the music room and we talked a little.
records.en_auxiliary: It's nothing, really... I just kind of ran into her in front of the music room and we talked a little.
records.en: It's nothing, really... I just kind of ran into her in the music room and we talked a little.

records.jp: ちなみに白井ちゃんはどこまで知ってるの？　多谷ちゃんのこと
records.en_original: In that case, I should start by asking you how much you know about Miss Taya.
records.en_auxiliary: In that case, I should start by asking you how much you know about her.
records.en: By the way, Shirai-chan, how much do you know about Taya-chan?

records.jp: ピアノで特待科にいるってことと……<CR>あとはきれいな音色を出せるってことくらい
records.en_original: I know that she's an incredible piano player and that that got her into the special class.
records.en_auxiliary: I know that she's an incredible piano player and that that's what got her into the special class.
records.en: That she's in the Special Class for piano...<CR>and that she produces a beautiful sound. That's about it.

records.jp: そういえば、お父さんがＳＥやってるって聞いたかなぁ
records.en_original: Oh, and also that her dad is a software engineer.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, and also that her dad is a software engineer.
records.en: Oh, and also that her dad is a software engineer.

records.jp: そうそう、ＩＴ企業の社長をやってるんだよね。<CR>最近は上手くいってないけど、昔は随分成功してたみたい
records.en_original: That's right, he's a CEO of an IT company! They used to be pretty big, but things aren't going so well for them lately.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right, he's the CEO of an IT company! They used to be pretty big, but things aren't going so well for them lately.
records.en: Right. He's the president of an IT company.<CR>Things aren't going well lately, but apparently it was quite successful before.

records.jp: あとは、おばあさんが有名百貨店の会長をやってて<CR>その影響で小さな頃からピアノを習っているとか
records.en_original: Oh, also, her grandma is the chairman of a big department store, and she started Fumio on the piano at an early age.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, also, her grandma is the chairman of a big department store, and she started Fumio on the piano at an early age.
records.en: Her grandmother is the chairwoman of a famous department store,<CR>and that's why she's studied piano since she was little.

records.jp: スパルタに近い練習で、天才と呼ばれる腕を持つに至ったとか――<CR>わたしの持ってる情報はこれくらいかなー
records.en_original: She was so set on making Fumio a genius, she put her through a Spartan-worthy training regimen... But that's all I know.
records.en_auxiliary: She was so set on making Fumio a genius, she put her through a Spartan-worthy training regimen... But that's all I know.
records.en: Through almost Spartan-style training, she became skilled enough to be called a genius—<CR>That is about all the information I have.

records.jp: （相変わらずよく知ってるなぁ……）
records.en_original: ("That's all," she says. That's a lot!)
records.en_auxiliary: ("That's all," she says. That's a lot!)
records.en: (She knows as much as ever...)

records.jp: いいとこのお嬢さんなんだねー
records.en_original: Wow, sounds like she's a real heiress!
records.en_auxiliary: Wow, sounds like she's a real heiress!
records.en: So she's a girl from a well-off family.

records.jp: で、ヒナちゃんはどうしたいの？
records.en_original: So, what are you going to do with this information, Hina?
records.en_auxiliary: So, what are you going to do with this information, Hina?
records.en: So what do you want to do, Hina-chan?

records.jp: どうしたいって……だから、私は別に
records.en_original: Well... Nothing, really.
records.en_auxiliary: Well... Nothing, really.
records.en: What do I want to do...? Like I said, it's nothing.

records.jp: あ、そうだ。言い忘れていたけど、多谷ちゃん<CR>最近すごく苦労していることがあるみたいだよ
records.en_original: Oh, yeah. I forgot to mention, seems like Taya's really been struggling recently.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, yeah. I forgot to mention, but it seems like Taya's really been struggling recently.
records.en: Oh, right. I forgot to mention that Taya-chan<CR>seems to be having a really hard time lately.

records.jp: 発表会のこと？
records.en_original: Because of her recital?
records.en_auxiliary: Because of her recital?
records.en: Because of her recital?

records.jp: あ、知ってたんだ？　そう、今度、多谷ちゃん<CR>結構、大きめの演奏会に出るっぽいんだよ
records.en_original: Oh, so you knew? You're right, she's got a pretty big recital coming up.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, so you knew? Yeah, she's got a pretty big recital coming up.
records.en: Yeah, Taya-chan is apparently performing<CR>at a fairly large concert soon.

records.jp: でも、ちょっとスランプ気味で<CR>上手くできるかナイーブになってるみたい
records.en_original: But her anxiety over whether she'll be able to really compete has her in a bit of a slump.
records.en_auxiliary: But her anxiety over whether she'll be able to really compete has her in a bit of a slump.
records.en: But she's in a bit of a slump<CR>and seems anxious about whether she can do well.

records.jp: ……わかった。亜子、情報ありがとう
records.en_original: ...Got it. Thanks for the info, Ako.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Got it. Thanks for the info, Ako.
records.en: ...Got it. Thanks for the info, Ako.

records.jp: どーいたしまして！　代わり……と言ってはなんだけど<CR>そこの二人の私生活を密着レポさせて――
records.en_original: You're very welcome! Now, as payment...why don't you set me up with a no-holds-barred interview with those two ladies.
records.en_auxiliary: You're very welcome! Now, as payment...why don't you set me up with a no-holds-barred interview with those two ladies.
records.en: You're welcome! In return...well, not exactly,<CR>but let me closely document the private lives of those two—

records.jp: だめ
records.en_original: Nope.
records.en_auxiliary: Nope.
records.en: Nope.

records.jp: 消すよ？
records.en_original: You want me to erase you?
records.en_auxiliary: You want me to erase you?
records.en: You want me to erase you?

records.jp: ううう……白井ちゃぁん
records.en_original: Eeeek! Shiraaaaai! Help!
records.en_auxiliary: Eeeek! Shiraaaaai! Help!
records.en: U-U-Ugh... Shirai-chaaaan!

records.jp: ま、まぁ、このお返しは改めてするってことで
records.en_original: W-Well, why don't we save the payback for another day?
records.en_auxiliary: W-well, why don't we save the payback for another day?
records.en: W-Well, I'll repay you properly another time.

records.jp: ねえねえ、その子のこと、様子を見に行かない？
records.en_original: Hey, hey, are you going to check up on that girl?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, hey, are you going to check up on that girl?
records.en: Hey, hey, should we go see how she's doing?

records.jp: スランプって言ってたけど、<CR>誰かと話すだけでも気がまぎれるんじゃないかな
records.en_original: Ako said she was in a slump, so don't you think talking to her might help raise her spirits a little?
records.en_auxiliary: Ako said she was in a slump, so don't you think talking to her might help raise her spirits a little?
records.en: Ako said she's in a slump,<CR>but maybe talking to someone would help take her mind off it.

records.jp: ライムはどっちでも
records.en_original: I'm ambivalent.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't care either way.
records.en: Lime is fine either way.

records.jp: 私は……やめておいたほうがいいと思うけど
records.en_original: I think...I should probably leave her be.
records.en_auxiliary: I think...I should probably leave her be.
records.en: I...think we should leave her alone.

records.jp: えっ、どうして？
records.en_original: Huh? But why?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? But why?
records.en: Huh? But why?

records.jp: だって、上手くいかない時は<CR>そうやって気を遣われるほうが鬱陶しいかもしれないし
records.en_original: Because sometimes, in situations like that, having someone worry about you makes things more irritating.
records.en_auxiliary: Because sometimes, in situations like that, having someone worry about you makes things more irritating.
records.en: When things aren't going well,<CR>having people fuss over you like that can be even more annoying.

records.jp: でも、放っておくのもかわいそうだよ！<CR>どんどん思い詰めて気持ちが悪いほうに行っちゃうかも
records.en_original: But, it's too sad not to help them out! I feel like they'd get stuck in an endless loop of negativity if I didn't!
records.en_auxiliary: But, it's too sad not to help them out! I feel like they'd get stuck in an endless loop of negativity if I didn't!
records.en: But it would be sad to leave her alone!<CR>She might keep brooding and spiral in a bad direction.

records.jp: それはそれで、ライムたちにとってはプラスになりそうだけど
records.en_original: Well, that would actually be a plus for us, in some ways.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, that would actually be a plus for us, in some ways.
records.en: That might be a plus for Lime and the others in its own way, though.

records.jp: ライム！　またそんなこと言って……！
records.en_original: Lime! You're being cruelly pragmatic again!
records.en_auxiliary: Lime! You're being cruelly pragmatic again!
records.en: Lime! Don't say things like that again...!

records.jp: とにかく、会いに行くとしても慎重に。<CR>よく考えて話しかけたほうがいいと思う
records.en_original: Nonetheless, tread lightly if you plan to go see her. Be sure to pick your words very carefully, too.
records.en_auxiliary: Regardless, tread lightly if you plan to go see her. Be sure to pick your words very carefully, too.
records.en: Anyway, if we do go see her, we should be careful.<CR>I think we need to think carefully before talking to her.

records.jp: 私たちの言葉が、どんな風に受け止められるか<CR>注意しないと
records.en_original: We have to be conscious of how she might interpret what we say to her.
records.en_auxiliary: We have to be conscious of how she might interpret what we say to her.
records.en: We need to be careful about<CR>how she might take what we say.

records.jp: うん、ライムはそれでいいよ
records.en_original: That's fine by me.
records.en_auxiliary: That's fine by me.
records.en: Yeah, Lime is fine with that.

records.jp: まぁ、ヒナちゃんがそう言うなら
records.en_original: Well, if you say so.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, if you say so.
records.en: Well, if you say so, Hina-chan.
